lead.event: IDX removes five stocks from the November 2026 short-selling list
lead.headline: IDX removes five stocks from November short-selling list, leaving none eligible
lead.blurb: The Indonesia Stock Exchange removed Astra International, Bank Central Asia, Barito Pacific, Bumi Resources and Indofood Sukses Makmur from the November list, leaving no stocks eligible for short selling. The exchange had only begun implementing short selling on 1 October. The removal followed the IHSG's 11.67% plunge on 16 October after MSCI proposed reclassifying Indonesia from emerging to standalone market. MSCI's decision is due by 30 June 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesian authorities implement capital-market reforms after MSCI turmoil
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia launches eight capital-market reforms after MSCI turmoil
market_structure_policy.blurb: OJK and BEI are raising the minimum free float from 7.5% to 15% as part of the package. BEI plans to exclude 80 high-concentration stocks, representing about 18% of IHSG weight, from the IHSG, IDX30, LQ45 and IDX80 from 2 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: OJK and BEI launched eight reforms, including raising the minimum free float from 7.5% to 15%.

deals_control.event: Dian Swastatika Sentosa buys BSD City land for data centers
deals_control.headline: DSSA agrees to buy Rp3.1 trillion of BSD City land for data centers
deals_control.blurb: Dian Swastatika Sentosa's subsidiary signed the binding agreement on 26 October for about 166,261 sq m in D-Hub SEZ Cluster 2B, with BSDE subsidiary Surya Inter Wisesa as seller. The acquisition is intended to support data-center development. Analysts recommended a wait-and-see stance on DSSA shares, citing capital expenditure, funding, data-center utilization and electricity supply.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Analysts recommended a wait-and-see stance on DSSA shares, citing capital expenditure, funding, data-center utilization and electricity supply.

deals_control.event: Bank Mandiri sells its Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.headline: BMRI plans to sell its 20% Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.blurb: The conditional agreement, signed 26 October, also covers Inhealth’s 45.14% stake in Fitaja Digital Nusantara. Completion remains subject to required approvals, after which IFG Life would own all of Inhealth.

deals_control.event: BIKE acquires a 72% stake in coal miner Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.headline: BIKE acquires 72% of Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.blurb: Berau Usaha Mandiri holds about 22 million metric tons of proven reserves across a roughly 500-hectare concession in East Kalimantan. Bhineka management targets annual production of 1.5 million to 2.5 million metric tons.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Chandra Asri terminates and relaunches its share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TPIA ends Rp1tn buyback and starts new program of up to Rp2tn
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Chandra Asri’s new program allows purchases of up to 1.6 billion shares through 28 January 2027, at no more than Rp3,000 per share. BCA Sekuritas will execute purchases using internal cash.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Gold Resources secures a US$435 million loan facility
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS secures a US$435 million loan facility
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Gold Resources signed the agreement on 26 October with five lenders. It comprises a US$150 million term loan and up to US$285 million revolving credit, priced at the applicable compounded benchmark rate plus a 2.75% annual margin. The unsecured facility matures on 26 October 2031 and will fund debt repayment, capex and working capital.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: NexAI Digital schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MGLV schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: NexAI Digital will issue 285.73 million shares at Rp8,880 each, at 15 rights for every 100 shares. Majority shareholder Nextier Datamate Center, which holds 62.71%, says it will exercise all its entitlements, worth about Rp1.59 trillion. Cum rights trading in regular and negotiation markets starts 4 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BNI conducts a Rp547 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBNI announces share buyback of up to Rp547 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BNI shares had fallen more than 20% since the start of 2026. The bank will fund the buyback entirely from internal cash during the period ending 27 January 2027. Repurchased shares will later be transferred as treasury shares under OJK regulations.

earnings_guidance.event: Bumi Resources Minerals reports Q3 2026 profit recovery
earnings_guidance.headline: BRMS returns to profit with US$11.01 million Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: The quarter followed a Q2 net loss of US$4.78 million. Gold sales rose to 16,748 ounces from 6,301 ounces, and Bumi Resources Minerals attributed the improvement to higher sales volume and River Reef expansion work completed in July.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BRMS swung from a Q2 net loss of US$4.78 million to Q3 net profit of US$11.01 million.

earnings_guidance.headline: COIN reports Rp40.78 billion nine-month net loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: The loss compares with Rp25.51 billion profit a year earlier, while basic loss per share was Rp2.77 versus earnings of Rp2.04. Indokripto’s revenue fell 34.78% to Rp73.78 billion, while general and administrative expenses rose to Rp121.47 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Esa Medika Mandiri reports lower revenue and a Q3 net loss
earnings_guidance.headline: EMMI reports nine-month net loss of Rp45.91 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Esa Medika Mandiri’s net sales fell to Rp97.73 billion for the nine months to 30 September, from Rp328.45 billion a year earlier, while operating expenses rose to Rp78.57 billion. It swung from a Rp17.91 billion profit, with basic loss per share of Rp28.19; shares fell 3.41 percent to 396 in intraday trading on 29 October.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports 2026 nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports 2026 nine-month profit up 20.7% to Rp45.5 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s bank-only loans rose 16% year on year to Rp1,605.8 trillion as of September 2026, while third-party funds increased 17.7% to Rp1,750.2 trillion. Gross non-performing loans improved to 0.98% from 1.03% a year earlier, and the bank-only capital adequacy ratio was 18.4%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Bank Mandiri’s bank-only loans grew 16% year on year to Rp1,605.8 trillion.

other.event: Perusahaan Gas Negara secures long-term gas and LNG supply agreements
other.headline: PGAS signs North Hub LNG purchase agreement worth about US$1.55 billion
other.blurb: PGN’s sellers include Pertamina and several Searah and Eni entities. Deliveries are scheduled from 2029 through 31 December 2037, with an option to extend to 31 December 2038. PGN said the deal could strengthen its portfolio and support LNG-sourced gas trading.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: PGAS separately signed a North Hub LNG purchase agreement valued at about US$1.55 billion, with deliveries from 2029 through 2037.
